title: Profile
description: A named class of Clank that determines which standards apply.

id.description: Short kebab-case identifier, e.g. news-based, sku-based.

inherits.description: Other profile ids this one inherits standards from. Keep shallow: one level is expected.

standards.description: Standard ids that apply to this profile, in addition to any inherited ones.

members.description: Optional: known Clanks currently classified under this profile.
